descriptions.archive_logs_search-logs: List archive search log entries in a time range. Body: data=[{start,end,query}], all optional. Example: {"data":[{"start":"<ISO 8601>","end":"<ISO 8601>","query":"<text or address>"}]}. Returns data[0].logs[] with createTime, emailAddr, searchText, searchReason and source. Requires app role permission: Archive | Search Logs | Read.
descriptions.archive_logs_searches: List archive searches run by admins and users. Body: data=[{query}], optional. Example: {"data":[{"query":"<text or address>"}]}. No time range; use archive_logs_search-logs for one. Returns data[0].logs[] with createTime, emailAddr, isAdmin, searchText and searchReason. Requires app role permission: Archive | Search Logs | Read.
descriptions.archive_logs_views: List archived messages that admins opened. Body: data=[{start,end,query}], all optional. Example: {"data":[{"start":"<ISO 8601>","end":"<ISO 8601>","query":"<viewer, sender, recipient or subject text>"}]}. Returns one row per view with viewer, viewed, subject, from, to and messageDate. Requires app role permission: Archive | View Logs | Read.
descriptions.audit_events: Fetch admin console audit events by time range. Body: data=[{startDateTime,endDateTime,categories,query}]. Example: {"data":[{"startDateTime":"<ISO 8601>","endDateTime":"<ISO 8601>","categories":["<category code>"],"query":"<text>"}]}; startDateTime and endDateTime are required, category codes come from audit_categories. Returns events with id, eventTime, category, auditType and eventInfo. Requires app role permission: Account | Logs | Read.
descriptions.dlp_logs: List Data Leak Prevention policy hits. Body: data=[{from,to,query,searchField,actions,routes}], all optional. Example: {"data":[{"from":"<ISO 8601>","to":"<ISO 8601>","query":"<text>","searchField":"senderAddress|recipientAddress|subject|policy|all","actions":["hold","bounce"],"routes":["inbound|outbound|internal|all"],"oldestFirst":false}]}; from and to are the time range, not addresses. Returns data[0].dlpLogs[] with eventTime, senderAddress, recipientAddress, subject, policy, action and route. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Monitoring | Data Leak Prevention | Read.
descriptions.email_send: Send a real email as the calling account. Body: data=[{to:[{emailAddress}],subject,plainBody:{content}}]. Example: {"data":[{"to":[{"emailAddress":"<address>","displayableName":"<name>"}],"subject":"<subject>","plainBody":{"content":"<text>"}}]}; to and subject are required; cc, bcc, htmlBody and attachments (file tokens from files_upload) are optional. Returns messageId, messageDateHeader and any invalidRecipients. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Account | Dashboard | Read.
descriptions.held_find: Find held messages in a time window. Body: data=[{start,end,admin,searchBy:[{fieldName,value}],filterBy}]. Example: {"data":[{"start":"<ISO 8601>","end":"<ISO 8601>","admin":true,"searchBy":[{"fieldName":"all|from|to|subject|senderIP|heldReason|policyInfo","value":"<text>"}],"filterBy":[{"fieldName":"route|heldGroup|attachments|spamverdict","value":"<value>"}]}]}; admin defaults to false, which returns only the caller's own held mail. Returns data[0].heldEmails[] with id, heldReason, heldGroup, policyInfo, fromEnv, route and heldSince. Requires app role permission: Account | Monitoring | Held | Read.
descriptions.held_list: List held messages with hold reason and policy. Body: data=[{start,end,admin,searchBy:{fieldName,value}}]. Example: {"data":[{"start":"<ISO 8601>","end":"<ISO 8601>","admin":true,"searchBy":{"fieldName":"all|subject|sender|recipient|reasonCode|senderIP","value":"<text>"}}]}. Returns rows with id, reason, reasonCode, policyInfo, from, to, subject and dateReceived. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Account | Dashboard | Read.
descriptions.held_reject: Reject held messages permanently, optionally notifying the sender. Body: data=[{ids,reasonType,notify}]. Example: {"data":[{"ids":["<held message id>"],"reasonType":"MESSAGE CONTAINS UNDESIRABLE CONTENT","message":"<note to sender>","notify":false}]}; ids is required; reasonType is one of the five Mimecast reject reasons. Returns per-id {id, reject} results. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Account | Monitoring | Held | Edit.
descriptions.held_release: Release held messages to recipients; cannot be undone. Body: data=[{id}], one per message, up to 25. Example: {"data":[{"id":"<held message id>"},{"id":"<another id>"}]}. Returns per-id {id, release} results. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Account | Monitoring | Held | Edit. Prefer held_release_safe, which refuses impersonation, malware and policy holds without an override and records a ticket.
descriptions.held_release-logs: Held-message release and reject log with operator and hold reason. Body: data=[{start,end,searchBy,filterBy}]. Example: {"data":[{"start":"<ISO 8601>","end":"<ISO 8601>","searchBy":{"fieldName":"all|operator|from|to|subject|info|heldReason","value":"<text>"},"filterBy":[{"fieldName":"route|status|attachments","value":"<value>"}]}]}; all fields optional; status takes released or rejected. Returns data[0].heldReleaseLogs[] with id, operator, released, heldReason, policy, rejectReason, spam and SPF/DKIM/DMARC detail. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Monitoring | Held | Read.
descriptions.journaling_get-service: Get journaling connector configuration and status. Body: data=[{id}]; omit id to get every connector. Example: {"data":[{"id":"<connector id>"}]}. Returns enabled, transferProtocol, messageFormat, queueSize, statusInfo and the SMTP or POP3 connection settings. Requires app role permission: Services | Journaling | Read.
descriptions.messages_get: Full detail for one tracked message, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks. Body: data=[{id}] from messages_search. Example: {"data":[{"id":"<id from messages_search trackedEmails>"}]}. Returns status, deliveredMessage, recipientInfo, retentionInfo and spamInfo. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Gateway | Tracking | Read.
descriptions.messages_get-file: Get a pre-signed download URL for a message file. Body: data=[{id}]. Example: {"data":[{"id":"<secure id>"}]}. Returns data[0].urls[], short-lived links that download the file. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Account | Dashboard | Read.
descriptions.messages_search: Track and trace messages by sender, recipient, subject or status. Body: data=[{start,end,advancedTrackAndTraceOptions}]. Example: {"data":[{"start":"<ISO 8601>","end":"<ISO 8601>","advancedTrackAndTraceOptions":{"from":"<address or domain>","to":"<address or domain>","subject":"<text>","senderIP":"<ip>"},"status":["held","rejected","delivery"],"route":["inbound"],"searchReason":"<why you are tracing>"}]}; send messageId instead of the options to trace one known message. Returns data[0].trackedEmails[] with id, status, fromEnv, subject, spamScore and spamVerdict; pass an id to messages_get. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Gateway | Tracking | Read.
descriptions.processing_find: Find messages stuck in the processing queue. Body: data=[{type,start,end,searchBy,filterBy}], all optional. Example: {"data":[{"type":"processing|bulk_processing","start":"<ISO 8601>","end":"<ISO 8601>","searchBy":{"fieldName":"ALL|fromAddress|toAddress|subject|info|remoteIp","value":"<text>"},"filterBy":[{"fieldName":"route|attachments","value":"<value>"}],"sortBy":"createTime","sortOrder":"asc|desc"}]}. Returns data[0].messages[] with id, attempts, nextAttempt, info, remoteIp, routing and created. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Monitoring | Processing | Read.
descriptions.queues_get: Inbound and outbound email queue counts over a time window, to spot a backlog. Body: data=[{start,end}], both required. Example: {"data":[{"start":"<ISO 8601>","end":"<ISO 8601>"}]}. Returns inboundEmailQueue[] and outboundEmailQueue[] as {date, count} points. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Account | Dashboard | Read.
descriptions.rejections_list: List email messages rejected at the gateway (7-day lookback). Body: data=[{start,end,admin,mailbox,searchBy}]. Example: {"data":[{"start":"<ISO 8601>","end":"<ISO 8601>","admin":true,"searchBy":{"fieldName":"all|from|to|type|info|remoteIp","value":"<text>"}}]}; all fields optional. Returns data[0].rejections[] with fromAddress, toAddress, info, spamScore, ipAddress and created. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Monitoring | Rejections | Read.
descriptions.senders_permit-or-block: Permit or block one sender for one recipient. Body: data=[{sender,to,action}], action permit or block. Example: {"data":[{"sender":"<sender address>","to":"<recipient address>","action":"block"}]}; sender and to are required; permit bypasses spam checks, block rejects that sender for that recipient. Returns the managed-sender entry with id, sender, to and type. MX-based (Cloud Gateway) deployments only. Requires app role permission: Gateway | Managed Senders | Edit.
descriptions.ttp_attachment-logs: List Attachment Protect sandbox logs. Body: data=[{from,to,result,route,oldestFirst}], all optional. Example: {"data":[{"from":"<ISO 8601>","to":"<ISO 8601>","result":"all|safe|malicious|timeout|error|unsafe","route":"all|inbound|outbound|internal","oldestFirst":false}]}; from and to are the time range. Returns data[0].attachmentLogs[] with date, fileName, fileHash, result, actionTriggered, senderAddress and recipientAddress. Requires app role permission: Monitoring | Attachment Protection | Read.
descriptions.ttp_impersonation-logs: List Impersonation Protect logs. Body: data=[{from,to,searchField,query,actions,taggedMalicious}], all optional. Example: {"data":[{"from":"<ISO 8601>","to":"<ISO 8601>","searchField":"senderAddress|recipientAddress|subject|definition|all","query":"<text>","actions":["hold","bounce","none"],"taggedMalicious":true,"oldestFirst":false}]}; query is required when searchField is set. Returns data[0].impersonationLogs[] with eventTime, senderAddress, recipientAddress, identifiers, action and taggedMalicious. Requires app role permission: Monitoring | Impersonation Protection | Read.
descriptions.ttp_url-logs: URL Protect click logs: who clicked which link. Body: data=[{from,to,scanResult,route,oldestFirst}], all optional. Example: {"data":[{"from":"<ISO 8601>","to":"<ISO 8601>","scanResult":"clean|malicious|suspicious|all","route":"all|inbound|outbound|internal","oldestFirst":false}]}; from and to are the time range. Returns data[0].clickLogs[] with date, url, userEmailAddress, scanResult, category and action. For one URL, ttp_who_clicked filters and decodes for you. Requires app role permission: Monitoring | URL Protection | Read.
descriptions.urls_decode: Decode Mimecast-rewritten URL Protect URLs back to the original, up to 25. Body: data=[{url}], one object per URL. Example: {"data":[{"url":"<rewritten link>"}]}. Returns per-link {url, success}. Requires app role permission: Account | Dashboard | Read.
